name: Life of the Party
source:
Life of the Party is a 5 minute visual novel following Kasey as she chooses a blunt to smoke at a party being thrown by her friend Wrench.

[From [url=https://junimadii.itch.io/life-of-the-party]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Life of the Party》是一部时长约5分钟的视觉小说。Kasey在朋友Wrench举办的派对上，挑选了一支大麻雪茄来抽。

[摘自[url=https://junimadii.itch.io/life-of-the-party]Itch.io[/url]]
